sample_unit: patient information leaflets (5 anticoagulants x 3 LLMs plus FDA comparator)

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated and FDA anticoagulant leaflets versus recommended reading grade
links.effect: All materials exceeded the recommended sixth- to eighth-grade range on most of seven readability indices; FDA leaflets were the most complex.
links.quote: All materials exceeded the recommended sixth- to eighth-grade range on most indices, with FDA leaflets the most complex.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM leaflet output across repeated generations same day and Days 1, 14, 28
links.effect: No significant within-model differences; largest mean difference 0.23 points.
links.quote: Output was stable across generations, with no significant within-model differences and the largest mean difference of 0.23 points.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLM-generated patient information leaflets for oral anticoagulants on quality, usability, readability, and reproducibility against FDA-referenced materials, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
